Whether or not you have this one characteristic will make or break your success on a significant weightloss journey.

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Eating less isn't always the answer. For years, we've been told that if we want to lose weight, we need to eat less. So we skip meals, cut portions, avoid carbs and try to get by on as little food as possible. But here's where that approach can backfire, especially in midlife. When you're constantly trying to eat less, you're often missing out on the very things that make fat loss easier to manage. Protein to help keep you full and maintain muscle. Fibre to support digestion, gut health and keep hunger in check. Food volume, so you can eat satisfying meals without consuming excessive calories. And when you're hungry all the time, it's much harder to stick to your calorie goals. You end up snacking, picking at food or overeating later in the day. The answer isn't to keep cutting calories. It's to make the calories you're eating work harder for you. Build your meals around protein, add plenty of fibre-rich foods and fill your plate with foods that give you more volume for fewer calories. You still need a calorie deficit to lose fat, but you don't need to spend your days feeling hungry and deprived. Eating smarter, not just eating less, can make all the difference. 🚨 SMASH OR PASS? FAT LOSS FOOD EDITION 🔥 Some foods LOOK healthy but could be making it harder for you to lose those stubborn 30-50 pounds. Here’s what I’d smash vs pass if your goal is to get leaner without starving yourself 👇 🥚 Whole Eggs: SMASH ✅ Great source of healthy fats and nutrients, but not as protein-dense as you might think. 🥜 Mixed Nuts: PASS ❌ Healthy fats, but extremely calorie-dense and way too easy to overeat. 🥣 Nonfat Greek Yogurt: SMASH ✅ High protein, low calorie, and keeps you full for hours. 🧃 Fruit Juice: PASS ❌ Easy to drink hundreds of calories without the filling fiber you’d get from whole fruit. 🥔 Boiled Potatoes: SMASH ✅ One of the most filling foods you can eat. Perfect for keeping hunger under control. 🥩 Lean Steak: SMASH ✅ Packed with protein to help preserve muscle while losing fat. 🍿 Air-Popped Popcorn: SMASH ✅ High-volume, low-calorie snack that satisfies those salty cravings. 🥣 Granola: PASS ❌ Small portions pack a TON of calories. Easy to overeat without realizing it. 💪 Whey Isolate: SMASH ✅ One of the easiest and most convenient ways to hit your daily protein goal. 🍫 Protein Bars: PASS ❌ Some are basically candy bars with a little extra protein. Check the calories before grabbing one. You don’t need to eliminate your favorite foods to lose fat. You just need to make smarter choices that keep you FULL while staying in a calorie deficit. That’s how you lose 30-50 pounds without feeling like you’re constantly dieting. 🔥 Follow @cohnan for simple fat loss tips that actually fit your busy lifestyle.
